personal.headline: I'm Rooney Akpesiri.
personal.introduction:
I've experienced nonprofit work from almost every side.

I've served as a nonprofit volunteer, staff member, founder and executive director, board member, coach, and fundraising consultant.
personal.experience: I've helped organizations raise money, recruit board members, strengthen their leadership, develop fundraising strategies, and plan for their future.
personal.philosophy:
But throughout these experiences, I've come to believe something very strongly.

There are many things nonprofit founders and executive directors spend thousands of dollars hiring professionals to do that they could actually accomplish themselves.

Sometimes, all they need is someone who understands the process, can show them what to do, and can give them the right tools to get started.

That's one of the reasons I decided to step away from my previous consulting role and build my own business.

I wanted to make my knowledge and experience accessible to nonprofit leaders who are willing to take charge of solving the challenges facing their organizations.

I believe there's no better place to apply yourself and develop your abilities than in your own organization.
personal.services:
Today, I work with nonprofit founders and executive directors on fundraising, board recruitment, board development, strategic planning, organizational development, and other challenges they encounter while building their organizations.

My goal is to help you achieve the solutions your organization needs, with the knowledge, tools, and guidance to do the work yourself.

And I'd love to hear about your organization.
personal.consultationDescription:
If you're starting a nonprofit, already leading one, or facing a challenge you want to resolve, you can book a professional consultation with me.

We'll discuss your organization, what you're trying to accomplish, and the problems you're facing.

I'll help you identify the areas that need attention, discuss where I believe you should begin, and show you practical approaches, frameworks, and tools you can use to address your priorities.
